fields.tagline: The New Jerusalem Carved in Rock
fields.tagline_en: The New Jerusalem Carved in Rock
fields.tagline_fr: La nouvelle Jérusalem taillée dans le roc
fields.description: An extraordinary complex of eleven monolithic, monolithic rock-hewn churches carved entirely out of pink volcanic tuff in the 12th century.
fields.description_en: An extraordinary complex of eleven monolithic, monolithic rock-hewn churches carved entirely out of pink volcanic tuff in the 12th century.
fields.description_am: በ12ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ሙሉ በሙሉ ከሮዝ እሳተ ገሞራ ጤፍ የተቀረጸ ያልተለመደ አስራ አንድ አሃዳዊ፣ አሃዳዊ ውቅር አብያተ ክርስቲያናት።
fields.description_fr: Un complexe extraordinaire de onze églises monolithiques taillées dans le roc entièrement taillées dans du tuf volcanique rose au XIIe siècle.
fields.history: Commissioned by King Lalibela of the Zagwe Dynasty, who sought to recreate Jerusalem on Ethiopian soil after Muslim conquests halted Christian pilgrimages to the Holy Land.
fields.history_en: Commissioned by King Lalibela of the Zagwe Dynasty, who sought to recreate Jerusalem on Ethiopian soil after Muslim conquests halted Christian pilgrimages to the Holy Land.
fields.history_am: የዛግዌ ሥርወ መንግሥት ንጉሥ ላሊበላ ተልእኮ የሰጠው፣ በኢትዮጵያ ምድር ላይ እየሩሳሌምን ለመፍጠር የጣረው የሙስሊሞች ወረራ ወደ ቅድስት አገር የሚደረገውን የክርስቲያን ጉዞ አቁሟል።
fields.history_fr: Commandé par le roi Lalibela de la dynastie Zagwe, qui cherchait à recréer Jérusalem sur le sol éthiopien après que les conquêtes musulmanes aient interrompu les pèlerinages chrétiens en Terre Sainte.
fields.culture: The spiritual heart of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church, alive with white-robed pilgrims, ancient liturgical chanting, and vibrant religious festivals like Genna (Christmas).
fields.culture_en: The spiritual heart of the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church, alive with white-robed pilgrims, ancient liturgical chanting, and vibrant religious festivals like Genna (Christmas).
fields.culture_am: የኢትዮጵያ ኦርቶዶክስ ተዋሕዶ ቤተ ክርስቲያን መንፈሣዊ ልብ ነጫጭ ካባ በለበሱ ምዕመናን፣ ጥንታዊ ሥርዓተ ቅዳሴ፣ እንደ ገና (ገና) ያሉ ደማቅ ሃይማኖታዊ በዓላት አሉ።
fields.culture_fr: Le cœur spirituel de l'Église orthodoxe éthiopienne de Tewahedo, animé de pèlerins en robe blanche, de chants liturgiques anciens et de fêtes religieuses vibrantes comme Genna (Noël).
fields.travel_tips: We will Hire an official local guide to navigate the labyrinthine tunnels connecting the churches. Wear slip-on shoes as you will be taking them off at every church entrance.
fields.travel_tips_en: We will Hire an official local guide to navigate the labyrinthine tunnels connecting the churches. Wear slip-on shoes as you will be taking them off at every church entrance.
fields.travel_tips_am: አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን የሚያገናኙ የላቦራቶሪዎችን ዋሻዎች ለማሰስ ኦፊሴላዊ የአካባቢ መመሪያ እንቀጥራለን። በየቤተክርስቲያኑ ደጃፍ እያወቃችኋቸው የሚንሸራተቱ ጫማዎችን ይልበሱ።
fields.travel_tips_fr: Nous embaucherons un guide local officiel pour parcourir les tunnels labyrinthiques reliant les églises. Portez des chaussures à enfiler car vous les retirerez à chaque entrée de l'église.
fields.weather_info: Mild highland climate, daytime temperatures around 22°C to 25°C, cool nights.
fields.weather_info_en: Mild highland climate, daytime temperatures around 22°C to 25°C, cool nights.

fields.name: Gondar
fields.description: A magnificent 17th-century royal enclosure filled with massive stone castles, banqueting halls, and palaces reminiscent of medieval Europe.
fields.description_en: A magnificent 17th-century royal enclosure filled with massive stone castles, banqueting halls, and palaces reminiscent of medieval Europe.
fields.description_am: በ17ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን የተገነቡ ግዙፍ የድንጋይ ካስሎች/ቤተ-መንግሥታት፣ የግብዣ አዳራሾች እና የአውሮፓ የመካከለኛው ዘመንን የሚያስታውሱ ህንጻዎች የሚገኙበት አስደናቂ ንጉሣዊ ቅጥር ግቢ።
fields.description_fr: Une magnifique enceinte royale du XVIIe siècle remplie de châteaux en pierre massifs, de salles de banquet et de palais rappelant l'Europe médiévale.
fields.history: Founded by Emperor Fasilides in 1636, Gondar served as the capital of the Ethiopian Empire for over two centuries, blending Portuguese, Indian, and local Aksumite architectural styles.
fields.history_en: Founded by Emperor Fasilides in 1636, Gondar served as the capital of the Ethiopian Empire for over two centuries, blending Portuguese, Indian, and local Aksumite architectural styles.
fields.history_am: በ1636 ዓ.ም በአፄ ፋሲለደስ የተመሰረተችው ጎንደር ለሁለት ክፍለ ዘመናት ያህል የኢትዮጵያ ኢምፓየር ዋና ከተማ ሆና ያገለገለች ሲሆን፣ የፖርቹጋል፣ የሕንድ እና የአካባቢውን የአክሱም የስነ-ሕንጻ ጥበቦችን አዋህዳ የያዘች ናት።
fields.history_fr: Fondée par l'empereur Fasilides en 1636, Gondar a été la capitale de l'empire éthiopien pendant plus de deux siècles, mélangeant les styles architecturaux portugais, indiens et aksoumites locaux.
fields.culture: Famous for the Debre Berhan Selassie Church with its iconic ceiling painted with rows of winged cherubs, and the annual Timkat (Epiphany) celebration.
fields.culture_en: Famous for the Debre Berhan Selassie Church with its iconic ceiling painted with rows of winged cherubs, and the annual Timkat (Epiphany) celebration.
fields.culture_am: የመላዕክት ፊቶች በተሳሉበት ዝነኛ ጣራዋ በሚታወቀው ደብረ ብርሃን ሥላሴ ቤተ ክርስቲያን እና በየዓመቱ በሚከበረው ታላቁ የጥምቀት በዓል ትታወቃለች።
fields.culture_fr: Célèbre pour l'église Debre Berhan Selassie avec son plafond emblématique peint de rangées d'angelots ailés et la célébration annuelle de Timkat (Épiphanie).
fields.travel_tips: Dedicate at least a half-day to exploring the Fasil Ghebbi royal enclosure and make sure to visit Fasilides' Bath, which is filled with water once a year for celebrations.
fields.travel_tips_en: Dedicate at least a half-day to exploring the Fasil Ghebbi royal enclosure and make sure to visit Fasilides' Bath, which is filled with water once a year for celebrations.
fields.travel_tips_am: የፋሲል ግቢ ንጉሣዊ ቅጥርን ለመጎብኘትቢያንስ ግማሽ ቀን ይመድቡ፤ እንዲሁም በዓመት አንድ ጊዜ ለጥምቀት በዓል ማክበሪያ በውሃ የሚሞላውን የፋሲለደስ መዋኛ ገንዳ መጎብኘትዎን ያረጋግጡ።
fields.travel_tips_fr: Consacrez au moins une demi-journée à l'exploration de l'enceinte royale de Fasil Ghebbi et assurez-vous de visiter les bains de Fasilides, qui sont remplis d'eau une fois par an pour les célébrations.

fields.name: Axum
fields.description: An ancient archaeological city renowned for its towering monolithic granite stelae, underground royal tombs, and deep biblical history.
fields.description_en: An ancient archaeological city renowned for its towering monolithic granite stelae, underground royal tombs, and deep biblical history.
fields.description_am: በሰማይ ጠቀስ ከአንድ ድንጋይ በተቀረጹ የግራናይት ሐውልቶቿ፣ ከምድር ሥር ባሉ የንጉሣውያን መቃብሮች እና በጥልቅ መጽሐፍ ቅዱሳዊ ታሪኳ የምትታወቅ ጥንታዊታ የሥነ- መሬት (አርኪኦሎጂ) ከተማ።
fields.description_fr: Une ancienne ville archéologique réputée pour ses imposantes stèles de granit monolithiques, ses tombeaux royaux souterrains et sa profonde histoire biblique.
fields.history: The capital of the powerful Aksumite Empire (1st–8th centuries AD), which dominated trade between Rome, India, and the Middle East, and was one of the first empires to adopt Christianity.
fields.history_en: The capital of the powerful Aksumite Empire (1st–8th centuries AD), which dominated trade between Rome, India, and the Middle East, and was one of the first empires to adopt Christianity.
fields.history_am: በሮም፣ በሕንድ እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ መካከል ያለውን ንግድ የበላይነት ተቆጣጥሮ የነበረው እና ክርስትናን ከተቀበሉ የመጀመሪያዎቹ ኢምፓየሮች አንዱ የሆነው ታላቁ የአክሱም ኢምፓየር (ከ1ኛው እስከ 8ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን) ዋና ከተማ ነበረች።
fields.history_fr: Capitale du puissant empire aksumite (Ier-VIIIe siècles après J.-C.), qui dominait le commerce entre Rome, l'Inde et le Moyen-Orient, et fut l'un des premiers empires à adopter le christianisme.
fields.culture: Believed by Ethiopian Christians to house the biblical Ark of the Covenant inside the chapel adjacent to the ancient Church of St. Mary of Zion.
fields.culture_en: Believed by Ethiopian Christians to house the biblical Ark of the Covenant inside the chapel adjacent to the ancient Church of St. Mary of Zion.
fields.culture_am: በኢትዮጵያ ክርስቲያኖች ዘንድ ከመጽሐፍ ቅዱሳዊው የጽዮን ማርያም ቤተ ክርስቲያን አጠገብ በሚገኘው እመቤታችን የቃል ኪዳኑ ታቦት ማደሪያ ቤተ-መቅደስ ውስጥ ታቦተ ጽዮን እንደምትገኝ ይታመናል።
fields.culture_fr: Les chrétiens éthiopiens croient qu'il abrite l'Arche biblique de l'Alliance à l'intérieur de la chapelle adjacente à l'ancienne église Sainte-Marie de Sion.
fields.travel_tips: Visit the archaeological museum first to understand the context of the stelae fields before walking the ruins.

fields.description_en: A dramatic landscape of vertical sandstone cliffs concealing ancient, rock-hewn churches built into high mountain ledges.
fields.description_am: በከፍታ ቦታዎች እና በቁልቁል የሰንደስቶን ገደሎች ላይ የተወቀሩ ጥንታዊ አብያተ ክርስቲያናትን በውስጡ የያዘ አስደናቂ ተፈጥሯዊ የመሬት አቀማመጥ።
fields.description_fr: Un paysage spectaculaire de falaises de grès verticales dissimulant d'anciennes églises taillées dans le roc, construites sur les corniches des hautes montagnes.
fields.history: Carved between the 4th and 6th centuries, these churches were placed in intentionally inaccessible spots for security, monastic isolation, and spiritual elevation.
fields.history_en: Carved between the 4th and 6th centuries, these churches were placed in intentionally inaccessible spots for security, monastic isolation, and spiritual elevation.
fields.history_am: ከ4ኛው እስከ 6ኛው ክፍለ ዘመን ባለው ጊዜ ውስጥ የተወቀሩት እነዚህ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ለደህንነት፣ ለመነኮሳት ብቸኝነትና ጸሎት እንዲሁም ለመንፈሳዊ ከፍታ ሲባል ታስቦባቸው ተደራሽ ባልሆኑ ገደሎች ላይ ተገንብተዋል።
fields.history_fr: Sculptées entre le IVe et le VIe siècle, ces églises ont été placées dans des endroits intentionnellement inaccessibles pour des raisons de sécurité, d'isolement monastique et d'élévation spirituelle.
fields.culture: Home to Abuna Yemata Guh, perhaps the most inaccessible church on earth, where local priests climb barefoot every day along vertical rock walls.
fields.culture_en: Home to Abuna Yemata Guh, perhaps the most inaccessible church on earth, where local priests climb barefoot every day along vertical rock walls.
fields.culture_am: በዓለም ላይ ለመድረስ በጣም አስቸጋሪው ቤተ ክርስቲያን እንደሆነ የሚነገረው የኣቡነ የማአታ ጉህ መገኛ ሲሆን፣ የአካባቢው ካህናት በየቀኑ በባዶ እግራቸው የቁልቁል ድንጋይ ገደሎችን እየወጡ ያገለግሉበታል።
fields.culture_fr: C'est là que se trouve Abuna Yemata Guh, peut-être l'église la plus inaccessible au monde, où les prêtres locaux grimpent pieds nus chaque jour le long des parois rocheuses verticales.
fields.travel_tips: This destination requires a serious climb. Hire local scouts/ropemen at the base, and do not attempt if you have severe vertigo.
fields.travel_tips_en: This destination requires a serious climb. Hire local scouts/ropemen at the base, and do not attempt if you have severe vertigo.
fields.travel_tips_am: ይህ ቦታ ፈታኝ የሆነ የተራራ እና የገደል እግር ጉዞን ይጠይቃል። ከተራራው ግርጌ የአካባቢውን መሪዎች/ገመድ ያዢዎች ይያዙ፤ እንዲሁም የከፍታ ፍርሃት (vertigo) ካለብዎት ለመውጣት አይሞክሩ።
fields.travel_tips_fr: Cette destination nécessite une sérieuse ascension. Embauchez des éclaireurs/cordistes locaux à la base et n'essayez pas si vous avez de graves vertiges.

fields.description_en: One of the lowest, hottest places on earth, famous for its surreal neon-yellow sulfur springs, geysers, and crystalline salt formations.
fields.description_am: በአስማታዊ በሚመስሉ ቢጫ አሲዳማ ፍልውሃዎቿ፣ ፍል ገንዳዎቿ እና የጨው ድንጋይ ምስረታዎቿ የምትታወቅ በምድር ላይ ካሉ ዝቅተኛ እና በጣም ሞቃታማ ቦታዎች አንዷ።
fields.description_fr: L'un des endroits les plus bas et les plus chauds de la planète, célèbre pour ses sources de soufre surréalistes jaune fluo, ses geysers et ses formations de sel cristallin.
fields.history: Formed by the pulling apart of three tectonic plates in the East African Rift system, exposing the earth's mantle to the surface.
fields.history_en: Formed by the pulling apart of three tectonic plates in the East African Rift system, exposing the earth's mantle to the surface.
fields.history_am: በምሥራቅ አፍሪካ ስምጥ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ሦስት የቴክቶኒክ ፕሌቶች (ምድር ሰሌዳዎች) ተነጣጥለው በመራቀቃቸው የተፈጠረች እና የምድር የውስጥ ክፍል (mantle) ወደ ውጭ የወጣበት ቦታ ናት።

fields.history: Known by the local Afar as the "Smoking Mountain," its lava lake has been active and continuously monitored by geologists since the late 19th century.
fields.history_en: Known by the local Afar as the "Smoking Mountain," its lava lake has been active and continuously monitored by geologists since the late 19th century.

fields.overview: Experience the ultimate pilgrimage through Ethiopia's legendary northern circuit. This comprehensive expedition unearths the cradle of Aksumite civilization, the majestic medieval castles of Gondar, the quiet island hermitages of Lake Tana, and the breathtaking hand-carved monolithic rock churches of Lalibela. Designed for history enthusiasts and cultural explorers alike.
fields.overview_en: Experience the ultimate pilgrimage through Ethiopia's legendary northern circuit. This comprehensive expedition unearths the cradle of Aksumite civilization, the majestic medieval castles of Gondar, the quiet island hermitages of Lake Tana, and the breathtaking hand-carved monolithic rock churches of Lalibela. Designed for history enthusiasts and cultural explorers alike.

fields.overview_fr: Vivez le pèlerinage ultime à travers le légendaire circuit nord de l'Éthiopie. Cette expédition complète découvre le berceau de la civilisation aksumite, les majestueux châteaux médiévaux de Gondar, les paisibles ermitages insulaires du lac Tana et les époustouflantes églises rupestres monolithiques sculptées à la main de Lalibela. Conçu pour les passionnés d'histoire et les explorateurs culturels.

fields.title_fr: Expédition extrême sur la dépression de Danakil
fields.tagline: Descend to Earth's lowest, hottest, and most alien volcanic outpost.
fields.tagline_en: Descend to Earth's lowest, hottest, and most alien volcanic outpost.
fields.tagline_am: በምድር ላይ ወደሚገኘው ዝቅተኛ፣ በጣም ሞቃታማ እና እንግዳ ወደሆነው የእሳተ ገሞራ ምድር ይውረዱ።

fields.overview: Journey into the heart of the Afar Triangle, dropping 125 meters below sea level to explore the otherworldly salt flats of Dallol and spend a night on the boiling caldera rim of Erta Ale volcano. A true bucket-list expedition for extreme adventurers.

fields.overview_am: ከባህር ወለል በላይ 125 ሜትር ዝቅ ብለው የሚገኙትን የዳሎል የጨው ሜዳዎች ለማሰስ እና በእርታ አሌ እሳተ ገሞራ የፈላ እሳተ ገሞራ አፍ ላይ ምሽቱን ለማሳለፍ ወደ አፋር ሶስት ማዕዘን እምብርት ጉዞ ያድርጉ። እጅግ ከባድ የጀብዱ ጉዞ ለሚወዱ ተጓዦች ልዩ የሆነ ተሞክሮ።
fields.overview_fr: Voyagez au cœur du Triangle Afar, plongeant à 125 mètres sous le niveau de la mer pour explorer les salines surnaturelles de Dallol et passez une nuit sur le bord de la caldeira bouillante du volcan Erta Ale. Une véritable expédition incontournable pour les aventuriers de l'extrême.

fields.title: Arrival in Addis Abeba & Fly to Axum

fields.description_fr: Arrivez à l'aéroport international de Bole et prenez votre correspondance intérieure pour Axoum. Enregistrez-vous à votre hôtel et profitez d'un briefing détendu en soirée.

fields.title: Secrets of the Aksumite Kingdom
fields.description: Full-day exploration of the Northern Stelae Field, King Kaleb’s tombs, the Queen of Sheba’s bath, and the Church of Our Lady Mary of Zion.
fields.description_en: Full-day exploration of the Northern Stelae Field, King Kaleb’s tombs, the Queen of Sheba’s bath, and the Church of Our Lady Mary of Zion.
fields.description_am: የሙሉ ቀን የሰሜን ስቴሌ ሜዳ፣ የንጉሥ ካሌብ መቃብሮች፣ የንግሥተ ሳባ መታጠቢያ እና የእመቤታችን የጽዮን ማርያም ቤተ ክርስቲያን የሙሉ ቀን አሰሳ።
fields.description_fr: Exploration d'une journée complète du champ de stèles du nord, des tombeaux du roi Kaleb, du bain de la reine de Saba et de l'église Notre-Dame-Marie de Sion.

fields.title: Overland Journey to Gondar
fields.description: Drive through the spectacular Tekeze River Gorge, winding through dramatic mountain switchbacks into Africa's historic royal city of Gondar.
fields.description_en: Drive through the spectacular Tekeze River Gorge, winding through dramatic mountain switchbacks into Africa's historic royal city of Gondar.
fields.description_am: በአስደናቂው የተከዜ ወንዝ ገደል ይንዱ።
fields.description_fr: Traversez les spectaculaires gorges de la rivière Tekeze, en serpentant à travers des lacets montagneux spectaculaires jusqu'à la ville royale historique d'Afrique de Gondar.

fields.title: The Royal Castles & Holy Pools
fields.title_fr: Les châteaux royaux et les piscines sacrées
fields.description: Tour the stone fortresses within the Fasil Ghebbi royal enclosure. Afternoon visit to the stunning angel-faced ceiling frescoes of Debre Berhan Selassie.
fields.description_en: Tour the stone fortresses within the Fasil Ghebbi royal enclosure. Afternoon visit to the stunning angel-faced ceiling frescoes of Debre Berhan Selassie.
fields.description_am: በፋሲል ጌቢ ንጉሣዊ ቅጥር ግቢ ውስጥ የሚገኙትን የድንጋይ ምሽጎች ጎብኝ። ከሰአት በኋላ የደብረ ብርሃን ስላሴን አስደናቂ መልአክ ያማከለ የጣሪያ ምስሎችን ጎብኝ።
fields.description_fr: Visitez les forteresses en pierre de l'enceinte royale de Fasil Ghebbi. L'après-midi, visite des superbes fresques du plafond aux visages d'ange de Debre Berhan Selassie.

fields.title: Lake Tana Island Hermitages
fields.title_fr: Ermitages de l'île du lac Tana
fields.description: Drive to Bahir Dar and board a private boat across Lake Tana. Explore the hidden 14th-century Ura Kidane Mehret monastery tucked away in the forest.
fields.description_en: Drive to Bahir Dar and board a private boat across Lake Tana. Explore the hidden 14th-century Ura Kidane Mehret monastery tucked away in the forest.
fields.description_am: ወደ ባህርዳር በመንዳት በጣና ሀይቅ ላይ በግል ጀልባ ተሳፈሩ። በ14ኛው መቶ ክፍለ ዘመን የተደበቀውን የኡራ ኪዳነ ምህረት ገዳም በጫካ ውስጥ ተደብቆ የነበረውን ገዳም አስሱ።
fields.description_fr: Conduisez jusqu'à Bahir Dar et montez à bord d'un bateau privé sur le lac Tana. Explorez le monastère caché d'Ura Kidane Mehret du XIVe siècle, niché dans la forêt.

fields.title: Flight to the New Jerusalem
fields.description: Take a short morning flight to Lalibela. Begin your pilgrimage at the northwestern cluster of rock churches, marveling at Biete Medhane Alem.
fields.description_en: Take a short morning flight to Lalibela. Begin your pilgrimage at the northwestern cluster of rock churches, marveling at Biete Medhane Alem.
fields.description_am: አጭር የጠዋት በረራ ወደ ላሊበላ ይሂዱ። ብእተ መድኃኔዓለምን በመደነቅ በሰሜን ምዕራብ የሮክ አብያተ ክርስቲያናት ክላስተር ጀምር።
fields.description_fr: Prenez un court vol matinal pour Lalibela. Commencez votre pèlerinage par le groupe d'églises rupestres du nord-ouest, en vous émerveillant devant Biete Medhane Alem.

fields.title: The Cross of Saint George
fields.description: Dedicate your morning to Biete Giyorgis, the iconic isolated cross-shaped church. Evening traditional dinner featuring authentic food, honey wine, and cultural dancing.
fields.description_en: Dedicate your morning to Biete Giyorgis, the iconic isolated cross-shaped church. Evening traditional dinner featuring authentic food, honey wine, and cultural dancing.
fields.description_am: ንጋትህን ለቢተ ጊዮርጊስ ስጥ፣ ዓይነተኛ የመስቀል ቅርጽ ያለው ቤተ ክርስቲያን። ትክክለኛ ምግብ፣ የማር ወይን እና የባህል ጭፈራ የሚያሳይ የምሽት ባህላዊ እራት።
fields.description_fr: Consacrez votre matinée à Biete Giyorgis, l'église emblématique isolée en forme de croix. Dîner traditionnel en soirée composé de plats authentiques, de vin de miel et de danses culturelles.

fields.title: Farewell Ethiopia
fields.description: Catch your return morning flight back to Addis Ababa. Enjoy a final souvenir shopping trip and day-room access before your international departure.
fields.description_en: Catch your return morning flight back to Addis Ababa. Enjoy a final souvenir shopping trip and day-room access before your international departure.

fields.description_fr: Prenez votre vol de retour le matin pour Addis-Abeba. Profitez d'une dernière séance de shopping de souvenirs et d'un accès à la chambre de jour avant votre départ international.
fields.accommodation_fr: Chambre de jour mise à disposition

fields.title: Drive from Mekelle to Dallol
fields.description: Descend from the highlands into the salt basin. Witness the camel caravans mining salt blocks.
fields.description_en: Descend from the highlands into the salt basin. Witness the camel caravans mining salt blocks.
fields.description_am: ከተራራማው ክፍል ወደ ጨው ተፋሰሱ ይውረዱ። የጨው ድንጋዮችን የሚጭኑ የኡግሮች موክብ (ካራቫን) ይመልከቱ።
fields.description_fr: Descendez des hauts plateaux jusqu'au bassin salant. Observez les caravanes de chameaux extrayant des blocs de sel.

fields.title: Neon Terraces of Dallol
fields.description: Morning trek through the sulfuric acid pools and iron geysers of Dallol. Drive to the base of the volcano.
fields.description_en: Morning trek through the sulfuric acid pools and iron geysers of Dallol. Drive to the base of the volcano.

fields.description_fr: Randonnée matinale à travers les bassins d'acide sulfurique et les geysers de fer de Dallol. Conduisez jusqu'à la base du volcan.

fields.content:
Traveling through Ethiopia is unlike any other backpacking journey on the planet. Because it was never colonized, its infrastructure, language, and cultural networks developed completely independently of European influence. To successfully navigate this magnificent country, your pre-trip preparation requires precise execution.
Visas and Entry Requirements
Do not rely on visas-on-arrival if you are flying into Bole International Airport in Addis Ababa. Always apply for your official Ethiopian e-Visa at least 3 to 5 days prior to departure through the official government portal (evisa.gov.et). Avoid third-party scam agencies that inflate fees by up to 300%. Print out a hard copy of your approved e-Visa certificate, as customs officers frequently request physical documents during power grid drops.
Financial Logistics: Cash is King
Ethiopia operates primarily on a cash-based economy. While major five-star hotels in Addis Ababa accept credit cards, local guesthouses, restaurants, and domestic tour operators out in the provinces do not.
•	ATM Use: Stick exclusively to Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE) or Dashen Bank ATMs. They are the most reliable, though they frequently run out of bills on weekends.
•	Currency Restrictions: It is strictly illegal to enter or leave the country with more than 3,000 Ethiopian Birr (ETB). Always carry clean, uncreased US Dollar bills ($100 denominations printed after 2013 fetch the safest authorized exchange rates at local bank branches).
Connectivity and Local SIM Cards
To stay connected, locate an official Ethio Telecom branch inside the arrival terminal at Bole International Airport or within the capital city. You must present your physical passport and a photocopy of your photo page to purchase a SIM card. Data packages are highly affordable; ask to activate an unthrottled 4G monthly data package. Note that internet connectivity can experience temporary regional outages, so always download offline maps (Maps.me or Google Offline) for your entire travel route before moving away from major city centers

ቪዛ እና የመግቢያ መስፈርቶች

በአዲስ አበባ ቦሌ ዓለም አቀፍ አየር መንገድ በሚደርሱበት ጊዜ በአየር መንገድ ላይ በሚሰጥ ቪዛ (visa-on-arrival) ላይ አይመኩ። ከጉዞዎ ከ3 እስከ 5 ቀናት ቀደም ብለው በኦፊሴላዊው የመንግስት ፖርታል (evisa.gov.et) በኩል ኢ-ቪዛ ያመልክቱ። ክፍያዎችን እስከ 300% የሚያስወድዱ የማጭበርበሪያ ኤጀንሲዎችን ያስወግዱ። የመብራት መቋረጥ በሚኖርበት ጊዜ የጉምሩክ መኮንኖች የታተመ ሰነድ ሊጠይቁ ስለሚችሉ የተፈቀደውን የኢ-ቪዛ ሰነድ ፕሪንት አድርገው ይያዙ።

የፋይናንስ ሁኔታ፡ ጥሬ ገንዘብ ወሳኝ ነው

ኢትዮጵያ በዋነኝነት በወረቀት/ጥሬ ገንዘብ የምትሰራ ሀገር ናት። በአዲስ አበባ ያሉ ትልልቅ ባለ አምስት ኮከብ ሆቴሎች ክሬዲት ካርድ የሚቀበሉ ቢሆንም፣ በክልሎች ያሉ የአካባቢ ሆቴሎች፣ ምግብ ቤቶች እና የሀገር ውስጥ የጉዞ ወኪሎች ግን ክሬዲት ካርድ አይቀበሉም።

የኤቲኤም (ATM) አጠቃቀም፡ የኢትዮጵያ ንግድ ባንክ (CBE) ወይም የዳሽን ባንክ ኤቲኤሞችን ብቻ ይጠቀሙ። በሳምንቱ መጨረሻዎች ገንዘብ ሊያልቁባቸው ቢችሉም በጣም አስተማማኝ ናቸው።

የገንዘብ ገደብ፡ ከ3,000 የኢትዮጵያ ብር (ETB) በላይ ይዞ መግባትም ሆነ መውጣት በጥብቅ የተከለከለ ነው። ሁልጊዜ ከ2013 በኋላ የታተሙ ንፁህ እና ያልተጨመደዱ የ$100 ዶላር ኖቶችን ይያዙ (እነዚህ በባንክ ቅርንጫፎች የተሻለ የምንዛሪ ዋጋ ያገኙልዎታል)።

የግንኙነት አገልግሎት እና የሲም ካርድ ምዝገባ

ኢንተርኔትና ስልክ ለመጠቀም በቦሌ አየር መንገድ ወይም በከተማ ውስጥ የሚገኝ የኢትዮ ቴሌኮም ቅርንጫፍ ያግኙ። ሲም ካርድ ለመግዛት ዋናውን ፓስፖርትዎን እና የፎቶ ኮፒውን ማቅረብ አለብዎት። የዳታ ፓኬጆች በጣም ርካሽ ናቸው፤ ገደብ የሌለው (unthrottled) የ4ጂ ወርሃዊ ዳታ እንዲያስሩልዎ ይጠይቁ። የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት በየክልሉ አልፎ አልፎ ሊቋረጥ ስለሚችል፣ ከዋና ዋና ከተሞች ከመውጣትዎ በፊት የካርታ መተግበሪያዎችን (Maps.me ወይም Google Offline Maps) ያውርዱ።
fields.content_fr:
Voyager à travers l’Éthiopie ne ressemble à aucun autre voyage de randonnée sur la planète. Parce qu’elle n’a jamais été colonisée, ses infrastructures, sa langue et ses réseaux culturels se sont développés de manière totalement indépendante de l’influence européenne. Pour réussir à naviguer dans ce magnifique pays, votre préparation avant le voyage nécessite une exécution précise.
Visas et conditions d'entrée
Ne comptez pas sur les visas à l’arrivée si vous arrivez à l’aéroport international de Bole à Addis-Abeba. Demandez toujours votre e-Visa officiel éthiopien au moins 3 à 5 jours avant le départ via le portail officiel du gouvernement (evisa.gov.et). Évitez les agences frauduleuses tierces qui gonflent les frais jusqu'à 300 %. Imprimez une copie papier de votre certificat e-Visa approuvé, car les agents des douanes demandent fréquemment des documents physiques lors des pannes de réseau électrique.
Logistique financière : le cash est roi
L’Éthiopie fonctionne principalement sur une économie basée sur les espèces. Alors que les principaux hôtels cinq étoiles d'Addis-Abeba acceptent les cartes de crédit, les maisons d'hôtes locales, les restaurants et les voyagistes nationaux dans les provinces ne le font pas.
• Utilisation des guichets automatiques : tenez-vous-en exclusivement aux guichets automatiques de la Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE) ou de la Dashen Bank. Ce sont les plus fiables, même s’ils manquent souvent de factures le week-end.
• Restrictions monétaires : Il est strictement illégal d'entrer ou de sortir du pays avec plus de 3 000 Birr éthiopien (ETB). Ayez toujours sur vous des billets en dollars américains propres et non froissés (les coupures de 100 $ imprimées après 2013 obtiennent les taux de change autorisés les plus sûrs dans les agences bancaires locales).
Connectivité et cartes SIM locales
Pour rester connecté, localisez une agence officielle d'Ethio Telecom à l'intérieur du terminal d'arrivée de l'aéroport international de Bole ou dans la capitale. Vous devez présenter votre passeport physique et une photocopie de votre page photo pour acheter une carte SIM. Les forfaits de données sont très abordables ; demandez à activer un forfait de données mensuel 4G non limité. Notez que la connectivité Internet peut subir des pannes régionales temporaires, alors téléchargez toujours des cartes hors ligne (Maps.me ou Google hors ligne) pour l'intégralité de votre itinéraire avant de vous éloigner des grands centres-villes.
